messages:
Mike R: FYI we're kicking off a segmented shadow launch for the new ratecard this Friday — 10% of active customers in US-E. Need a quick ops checklist and gating criteria. Any blockers?
Alisa: :thumbsup: who's owning the grandfathering mapping? we need to ensure orgs with legacy credits aren't double-charged.
Sophia: I'll own the mapping. need the customer export — @Mike can you attach the latest cohort CSV or point me to the BigQuery query?
Mike R: SQL below to pull the cohort, filter by active in last 30 days:
```
SELECT org_id, tier, legacy_credit_flag FROM finance.cohorts WHERE region='us-east' AND active_days>0
```
Alisa: also need invoice samples for the top-20 orgs in the cohort to verify line-item parity. Sophia, can you run that?
Sophia: running now. note: if any org shows non-zero legacy_credit after rate change, we should exclude them from the experiment.
Dave: product question — can this run as shadow (no live charges) but generate "what-if" invoices so we validate arithmetic and downstream UX? we don't want to risk live billing.
Jen Legal: prefer shadow invoices + audit log. if we run live on any subset, legal needs sign-off for grandfathering exceptions.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-1423 created: "shadow-ratecard-seg-launch" — assignees: Sophia, Alisa. https://tickets.redwood/FIN-1423
Alisa: rollout gating checklist (draft): 1) cohort export validated 2) top-20 invoice parity ok 3) no legacy credit mismatch 4) vendor sync verified 5) rollback plan in place
Mike R: vendor sync = sending new ratecard to billing vendor. vendor needs mapping table key: "legacy_plan_id -> new_plan_id". I'll attach mapping CSV to FIN-1423.
Sophia: quick results: top-20 run done, 2 orgs have credit_flag=true — proposing exclude list. sample: org_1291, credit: 1500, current_monthly: 0
Alisa: exclude list ok by finance. how long do we shadow? propose 48h min to collect tokenized usage deltas + invoice diffs.
Dave: we'll do A/B: A = shadow only; B = shadow + simulated emails to product for downstream UX. need to flag support and CS.
Mike R: agree. automation ask: if billing delta > 2% for any org, auto-disable that org in the experiment and push alert to #incidents.
Jen Legal: +1. and if a dispute arises during the shadow period, hold changes and escalate to legal+prod+finance.
Sophia: i'll push the updated cohort + exclude list to FIN-1423 in ~15m and add CSV export link. cc @Mike
Mike R: perfect. scheduling a 30m pre-launch sync Thu 09:30 PST. :calendar:
